title: Split tori over commutative rings
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Define the multiplicative $R$-group scheme $\mathbf G_{m,R}=\operatorname{Spec}R[z,z^{-1}]$, using affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and Laurent polynomial rings [def-weil-laurent-polynomial-ring]. Its multiplication, identity and inverse are given on coordinate rings by $z\mapsto z\otimes z$, $z\mapsto1$, and $z\mapsto z^{-1}$, satisfying the group-object diagrams of [def-sc-group-scheme] over $\operatorname{Spec}R$. For $r\in\mathbf N$, define the split torus $\mathbf G_{m,R}^r$ as the product over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-pc-fibre-product] of $r$ copies of this group, with the componentwise group law; the product for $r=0$ is the trivial group over $\operatorname{Spec}R$.

source.place: Author-hosted PDF https://sites.math.washington.edu/~jarod/papers/iwahori.pdf, Remark 3.5, printed p.5; Laurent Hopf algebra realizes the multiplicative group used there over R.
